summary: The SiteRecruitmentOpportunities module is designed for managing recruitment opportunities within a site. It provides user interface controls such as GridView for listing opportunities, and FormView for viewing and editing individual records.
purpose: To manage site recruitment opportunities, allowing users to add, edit, delete, and view opportunities.

fields.name: HeadingID
fields.description: Identifier for the heading of a site opportunity.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: The display order of the site opportunity.

fields.name: Response
fields.description: The response or URL pertaining to the site opportunity.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Identifier for the site associated with the recruitment opportunity.

actors.description: An individual who interacts with the SiteRecruitmentOpportunities module to manage opportunities.

workflows.name: Managing Site Recruitment Opportunities
steps: User loads the site recruitment opportunities page.
User can view a list of existing opportunities in a GridView.
User can add a new opportunity by switching the FormView to Insert mode and providing necessary details.
User can edit an existing opportunity by selecting an opportunity from the GridView, which switches the FormView to Edit mode.
User can delete an opportunity, prompting a confirmation and then removing the selected opportunity from the list.
After adding or editing, details can be saved, which updates the data source and refreshes the view.

business_rules: Only users with edit permissions can modify opportunities.
Users must provide a valid HeadingID and SortOrder when adding or updating opportunities.
validations: Ensure HeadingID is selected from the dropdown.
Ensure SortOrder is a valid integer.
Handle empty SortOrder by setting it to -1.
calculations: Convert SortOrder to an integer before saving to data source.
conditions: If no opportunities exist and the screen is editable, display a button to add new opportunities.
system_behavior: Automatically refresh the GridView after an add, edit, or delete operation.
Redirect the user to the main site profile page after completing an operation.
dependencies: Depends on UserSession for managing session state.
Relies on the DataLayer.SiteOpportunities class for data operations.
exceptions: Cancel operations if UserSession is not valid during data selection.
